description: ADTS at 22050 Hz of two channel pair frames and a third that holds two blocks, each a channel pair followed by SBR data, and ends 5 bytes before its stated length: a damaged frame, so its SBR data counts for nothing and the stream stays AAC LC.

skip.faad: faad -i prints twice the rate of any ADTS stream at 24 kHz or less, whatever its frames hold.
skip.faad_trace: faad2 reads one raw data block per ADTS frame and does not read the cut frame of two blocks.
